compounddef.initializer: template<typename T> concept gl::traits::c_graph_directional_tag = c_one_of<T, directed_t, undirected_t>

briefdescription.para: Validates if a type is a valid graph directional tag.

detaileddescription.para: The valid graph directional tags are directed_t and undirected_t. This concept is used to constrain template parameters that are intended to specify the directionality of a graph, ensuring that only valid tags can be used in such contexts.

parameterdescription.para: The type to evaluate against the concept.
